Name: PLY's Provence Farm Buildings
Author: polyesterday
Description:
[font=Arial][size=3]﻿💗 [/size][color=#d5a6bd][size=2]I’ve been reading all the comments — thank you so much for the kind words. It means a lot to see people enjoying the mod. [/size][/color]💗[/font][font=Arial][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][color=#ff7700][size=3]
[/size][/color][size=3][b][color=#ff7700]▣ Building Retexture – Now with CP Support[/color]
[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3][b]▪ Design Notes

[/b][/size][size=3]- Coops and Barns use the same texture across all upgrade levels  
[/size][size=3]- Some buildings are designed to connect naturally when placed side by side — see preview images  
[/size][size=3]- Some Obelisks share part of their textures, allowing flexible mixing  
[/size][size=3]- In the CP version, their styles can be changed via GMCM settings (PC only)  
[/size][size=3]- This mod was created with DaisyNiko’s Earthy Recolor in mind, but it also works fine without it  [/size][size=3]



[b][color=#ff7700]▣ About the CP Version
[/color]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]▪ Overview[/b]

I created a Content Patcher version for players who prefer CP-based mods.  
I tested it as best I could, but let me know if anything doesn’t work properly.  

[b]▪ How It Works (Compared to AT)[/b]

Unlike the AT version where you use a brush tool, the CP version applies textures automatically based on config settings — which many players are already familiar with.

From what I’ve found, Content Patcher by itself can’t apply different textures to multiple copies of the same building.  
That usually requires help from other mods.

Since that flexibility was important for my design — especially to keep it mobile-friendly — I took a different approach:

- I used cabin-type buildings (Plank / Log / Stone / Rustic Cabin) as alternate texture carriers.  
- These cabins are meant for decoration, not gameplay use.  
- You can place them next to other buildings to make them look like one connected structure.  
- You can change their appearance using Robin’s construction menu.  
- I adjusted the textures to match the size and footprint of each cabin.  
- Chimney smoke was removed from these decorative cabins so they blend in more naturally with other buildings.[/size]



[size=3][b]﻿[color=#ff7700]▣ Installation[/color]
[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3][b]─ Required Mods (AT version)[/b]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]- SMAPI

[/size][size=3]- Alternative Textures

[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3][b]─ How to Install (AT version)[/b]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]1. Download and unzip the AT version ([AT] PLY's Provence Farm Buildings)  
[/size][size=3]2. Place it in your Mods folder  
[/size][size=3]3. Launch the game 
[/size][size=3]4. Use the paint bucket tool in-game to change textures via Alternative Textures

[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]---

[/size][size=3][b]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]─ Required Mods (CP version)[/b]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]- SMAPI
[/size][size=3]- Content Patcher
[/size][size=3]

[/size][size=3][b]─ How to Install (CP version)[/b]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]1. Download and unzip [CP] PLY's Provence Farm Buildings  
[/size][size=3]2. If you're using SVE, also install [CP] PLY's Provence Farm Buildings - SVE Add-on  
[/size][size=3]3. Place folder in your Mods folder  
[/size][size=3]4. Launch the game[/size][size=3]




[/size][size=3][color=#e69138]▣ Extra for PC Users (CP Version Only) [/color]

[/size][size=3]The CP version supports GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu)  
[/size][size=3]You can easily change things like Obelisk styles in-game without editing files  
[/size][size=3]Check preview images for available options  

[/size][size=3]Note: This feature is only available for PC users 


[/size][color=#f9cb9c][size=3]
[/size][/color][size=3][color=#f9cb9c]▣ A Small Note [/color]

[/size]I hope you enjoy using this mod.  
If you run into any issues or have feedback, feel free to let me know.

Heads up:  
If you're using another mod that also changes building appearances, this one might not show up correctly.  
During testing, I had to disable a setting in another retexture mod to make this work.


Special thanks to FlashShifter for creating Stardew Valley Expanded.  
This mod includes additional support for SVE buildings.
